Qasam hai anjeer aur zaitoon ki
Aur is amn waale shehar ki
Hum ne insaan ko behtareen saakht mein paida kiya hai
Phir hum ne us ko past-tareen haalat ki taraf palta diya hai
Ilaawa un logon ke jo imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal anjaam diye, to un ke liye na khatm hone waala ajr hai
Phir tum ko roz-e-jaza ke baare mein kaun jhutla sakta hai
Kya Khuda sab se bada haakim aur faisla karne waala nahin hai
